What Apple Digital Legacy actually does — listing honesty

Apple Digital Legacy lets users designate Legacy Contacts who can request access to Apple Account data after the user's death or incapacity. Under Settings → [your name] → Sign-In & Security → Legacy Contact, users nominate trusted people and share an access key. After Apple verifies a death or incapacity request, Legacy Contacts may access photos, notes, documents, and other iCloud content the deceased person stored. Third-party apps may complement this by educating buyers, documenting Add Legacy Contact steps, or aligning privacy UX with estate and digital-asset workflows.   • Separate Digital Legacy from Recovery Contact and Recovery Key in copy — Recovery Contact is password-forgotten account recovery while alive (恢复联系人); Recovery Key is the 28-character offline backup (恢复密钥); Digital Legacy is post-death iCloud data access through Legacy Contacts (数字遗产, 遗产联系人). Digital Legacy–specific vocabulary — what translates differently in zh-Hans

Estate and digital-asset marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general localization guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers evaluate Apple Digital Legacy — not a literal paste of US marketing:

设置 → [你的姓名] → 登录与安全性 → 遗产联系人

Apple's Chinese Settings path is 设置 → [你的姓名] → 登录与安全性 → 遗产联系人. Screenshot walkthroughs and caption lines should mirror that path — not English "Sign-In & Security" badges alone, not 查找 (Find My), and not 家人共享 (Family Sharing). AppLocale uses the labels buyers see on a zh-Hans iPhone when your English gallery shows the Legacy Contact toggle or Add Legacy Contact enrollment sheet.

数字遗产 (Digital Legacy)

Apple's program name and the commerce term Chinese buyers search for post-death iCloud data access is 数字遗产. Ultra Digital Legacy badges on your US gallery should map to 数字遗产 or 超数字遗产 depending on your English source — not literal 数字遗留, which reads like machine translation.

遗产联系人 (Legacy Contact)

Apple's official zh-Hans label for the designated person who can request post-death Apple Account data access is 遗产联系人. Commerce copy may also use 数字遗产联系人 when buyers search those terms — but do not substitute 恢复联系人, which is Recovery Contact for password-forgotten account recovery while alive. Never substitute 家人 or 家庭成员 alone — Family Sharing uses different vocabulary.

Do not substitute 添加恢复联系人 (Add Recovery Contact), 生成恢复密钥 (Generate Recovery Key), or 开启家人共享 (Turn On Family Sharing) — those belong on sibling pages.
